graph.name: Snyk Developer-First AWS CodePipeline Integration
graph.notes: whiteboards a secure integration that allows developers to run security scans on their application code directly within AWS CodePipeline using Snyk's API and Serverless infrastructure.

edges.notes: Customer registers and enables Snyk integration in CodePipeline
AWS CodePipeline updates status back to Customer's console
AWS CodePipeline redirects user to Snyk's API Gateway for OAuth/Configuration
API Gateway writes configuration and mapping metadata to DynamoDB
Confirms record storage to Snyk UI flow
Subsequent pipeline runs trigger the Snyk Lambda function
Lambda registers event state changes in EventBridge
EventBridge triggers Step Functions workflow execution
Updates state machine status during scan processing
Step Functions request artifact locations and feed scan results back to CodePipeline
CodePipeline copies workspace artifacts into the customer S3 bucket
Source files and packages are pulled or prepared for scanning operations
